integrity: The proof is a finite counting argument from the published restriction and error definitions: fixed residual complements correspond to exactly \((n-2d)!\) partial injections, after which a union bound and the definition of the bipartite Zarankiewicz number give the stated corollaries. No experimental computation is used.
scientific_limitations: The theorem isolates only the output-support contribution to the reduced search-tree error. It does not control the path-feasibility term in the main reduction, prove the candidate family is a pseudo-solution in the target regime, or yield a new \(\mathrm{AC}^{0}[p]\)-Frege lower bound. An equivalent rectangular-hitting formulation may exist under different terminology outside the checked literature.
title: Leaf-label complements give an exact biclique lower bound for Krajíček search-tree error
